messages:
alex: Heads up — starting canary deploy for model-router v2 now. Plan is to enable the feature flag ff:burst_attenuation at 5% then step to 25% after 10m, 50% after 30m if metrics look good. Watch latency and error budget.

deploy-bot: /deploy started: model-router v2 -> canary (deploy id: dpl-2351112222). Rolling out to 3 pods. Logs: https://deploy.redwood/dpl-2351112222 :rocket:

maria: @alex good plan. quick Q — are we pinning cohorts to the old model if we see p95 spike?

alex: yes — pinning strategy: if p95 increases > 80ms over baseline or errors > 0.5% for 2 consecutive minutes, we pin 100% of affected cohorts back to v1. Manual rollback cmd below.

sam: I have a small script to flip flag percentages via the flags API. dropping it here:
```bash
# step 1: 5%
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood/flags/ff.burst_attenuation/toggle \
  -d '{"percent":5}'
```

jen: adding monitoring checklist:
- watch p50/p95 latencies for model-router (canary pods)
- alert on 5xx spike > 0.3%
- check trace sampling for cold-start errors
- verify kv-cache hitrate stays > 95%
:eyes:

alex: I'll start the flag at 5% now. tagging @maria for observability follow.

maria: ack. dashboards up. starting synthetic traffic ramp to simulate bursts.

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.burst_attenuation -> 5% (requested by alex).

sam: running the 10m window test, sending 200qps short bursts. so far p95 +12ms, errors flat.

jen: seeing slight tail on p95 but within threshold. no 5xxs.

alex: moving to next step: set to 25%. If anything looks off, we cut to 0% and pin cohorts.

sam: executing step: 25%...

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.burst_attenuation -> 25% (requested by sam).

maria: getting a small uptick in latency for one region (eu-west). p95 +45ms, error 0.45%. still below our kill switch, but close.

aj: (reacts) :thinking_face:  <-- (note: aj not in participants list for thread)

alex: thanks @maria. hold on the 50% bump for now. can we route eu-west traffic to reserved pool to isolate?

maria: shifting 30% of eu-west to reserved pool now.

sam: holding 50% step. keeping 25% for 20m while we watch.

jen: quick reminder: rollback command if needed:
```bash
# pin cohorts and set flag to 0%
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood/flags/ff.burst_attenuation/toggle -d '{"percent":0}'
# pin route rule
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/routes/pin -d '{"route":"model-router","version":"v1","cohorts":"*"}'
```

maria: after shifting reserves, eu-west stabilizing. p95 back to +10ms. errors down to 0.12%.

alex: great. proceed to 50% in 10m and start cutover plan doc update. leave canary at 50% for 30m then schedule gradual split if stable.

sam: will do the 50% toggle at +10m. leaving monitors and alerts set.

deploy-bot: scheduled task: toggle ff.burst_attenuation -> 50% at ts+600s (deferred).

jen: noted for release notes: mention burst attenuation default behavior, cohort pinning, and rollback commands. I'll draft a short blurb for the release channel.

alex: thanks all. if anything >= kill threshold, call rollback immediately and ping #oncall. :exclamation:

deploy-bot: deploy dpl-2351112222 status: canary running. next automated action: scheduled flag bump to 50% in ~10m.

sam: (10m later) flipping to 50% now.

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.burst_attenuation -> 50% (requested by sam).

maria: metrics look stable across regions after the bump. continuing observation window.

alex: leaving rollout window open for 30m, then we'll discuss full split. thanks team. :thumbsup:
